data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'jazaa' meaning 'reward' or 'gift'. In Islamic tradition, it is believed that this name signifies a gift bestowed by Allah upon the child, signifying blessings and favor from the Almighty. The name Jazoon carries the meaning “Gift from Allah” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jazoon usually hope their child will grow to embody gift from allah and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of Allah's blessings and divine favor.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jazoon total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
